scripts.text:
[Hugel Guide Granny]
Oh, hello~ you are one energetic adventurer.
Welcome to ^8B4513Hugel^000000. I am honored to guide you in this beautiful village.
If this is the first time for you to use the guide services, you should ask a lot of questions.
scripts.translation:
[毁葛向导婆婆]
哎呀，你好呀~真是个精神十足的冒险者。
欢迎来到^8B4513毁葛^000000，能给你介绍这么美的村子，我很高兴。
头一回找向导的话，有什么问题就多问问吧。

scripts.text:

When you click on the ^B9062F[location name]^000000, you'll receive the most advanced ^B9062FNavigation^000000 services!

[Hugel Guide Granny]
